result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.count_nodes()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Count the total number of nodes in the graph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L10966-L11010){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.count_nodes() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Count nodes](/assets/graphs/count-nodes.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="The shared four-node graph with every node, A to D, in the accent color and its id, 1 to 4, in a pill. The card returns the node count, 4." width="100%"} Returns the current number of nodes (vertices) in the graph, often written *n* or |V|. The count includes every node that has been added and not deleted, whether or not it has any edges, so isolated nodes are counted too. It is a constant-time lookup, so it's cheap to call even on very large graphs. Typical uses include sanity-checking the result of an import or generator, sizing loops or arrays, and computing quantities that depend on *n* (density, average degree, normalizing scores). The count ignores the current selection; use `count_selected_nodes()` to count only selected nodes. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The total number of nodes in the graph. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} A graph with three nodes and no edges still has three nodes -- edges don't matter for this count: ::: {#b56560c2 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_nodes(["A", "B", "C"]) ) graph.count_nodes() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 3 ``` ::: ::: Deleting a node immediately lowers the count: ::: {#82a9b8e4 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph.delete_node("B") graph.count_nodes() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 2 ``` ::: :::
